def evolved_p97(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i,j] = 1 if (i*i + j*j) <= (N*N//4) else 0
    # Position-based quadratic disk mask, no collective needed.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    ii = idx.view(N, 1)
    jj = idx.view(1, N)
    return ((ii * ii + jj * jj) <= (N * N // 4)).to(x.dtype)
